P.label: Preferred genetically characterized clinical sALS
criteria: Clinical diagnosis = ALS (excluding ALS-FTD/FTLD and non-ALS MND or concomitant neurodegenerative disease)
Non-positive family history of ALS or FTD (with P_strict = explicit negative family history and P_WGSneg_FHunk = unrecorded family history tracked as explicit sub-strata)

WGS sequenced with Negative C9orf72 repeat expansion call in available screening sources (excluding LR-WGS rows where C9orf72 Repeat Size = PEN unless confirmed by SR-WGS; with strict 154-P sub-stratum requiring a numeric non-PEN C9orf72 and ATXN2 repeat size call) and no clinical/WGS C9orf72 conflict

No qualifying Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic variants or high-confidence dominant LoF variants detected across the 18 mandatory genes (sequence_audit_union_v1.0.bed: 263 intervals, 77,971 bp across 18 gene prefixes), 8 conditional trigger genes, 4 curated ALS panel genes (ANG, TIA1, FIG4, SETX), and ATXN2 pathogenic repeat expansion in available screening sources (wgs_metadata, the 53 variant_annotations tables, and 97 raw open-access consortia sequencing hard-filtered VCFs; note that variant-only call tables do not provide per-sample 20x reference callability matrices)

U.label: Exploratory clinical sALS with unsequenced or incomplete genetics (R78)
criteria: Clinical diagnosis = ALS with non-positive family history
No known pathogenic variant, but either lacks WGS or has pending/undetermined C9orf72 repeat expansion status (N/A, PEN, N/D)

V.label: Sporadic presentation carrying a pathogenic/likely pathogenic ALS variant (grouped with F/G genetic comparator)
criteria: Clinical diagnosis = ALS with non-positive family history

Carries C9orf72 repeat expansion, ATXN2 pathogenic expansion, or a Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic sequence variant (MAF < 0.002, ClinVar P/LP without majority Benign classification, or dominant LoF in LoF-intolerant mandatory gene)

F.label: Familial ALS comparator (positive family history of ALS or FTD)
criteria: Clinical diagnosis = ALS with positive family history of ALS or FTD (verified or unverified relative with ALS/FTD)

Control_NPN.label: Neuropathologically normal non-neurological control
criteria: Clinical Group = Non-Neurological Control and Diagnostic Detail in ('N/A', 'Dermatomyositis', '')

Discordant_Excluded.label: Excluded due to unresolved clinical vs. WGS genetic conflict
criteria: Direct conflict between clinical chart C9orf72 report and SR-WGS C9orf72 repeat call without LR-WGS confirmation (specifically donor SD006/17 = CD09 = SD-006-17)
